title: Engine crashes after closing testing session via F8
body:
### Tested versions

Tested with 4.4.1 and 4.5.beta







### System information

Godot v4.5.beta7 - Void #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue Sep  2 01:06:37 UTC 2025 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (RADV NAVI21) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700K CPU @ 4.20GHz (8 threads) - 31.29 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have a crash (reproduceable) after normal closing a testing session ...  the crash occurs independented of 2D oder 3D ... it`s reproduceable with every project i tested ... > 10 projects ... 




### Steps to reproduce

Description:
- open my project (independent of 2D oder 3D ... reproduceable with every project i tested ... > 10 projects)
- start the testing via F5 
- do some testing with my game
- stop testing via F8
- Godot crashes with the following error message:
